Behind the prediction

From race data
to a probability.

A small, hands-on way to explore a machine learning model built for driver comparisons.

  1. Set up the comparison

    Enter Driver A minus Driver B feature differences, including grid positions, qualifying gaps, and recent finishing form. Or load a historical example.

  2. Let the forest weigh in

    Twenty trees each follow their own sequence of questions. Their leaf probabilities are averaged into one result.

  3. Explore the result

    See each driver’s predicted chance of finishing ahead and inspect the first tree’s decision path. Unknown inputs use training medians.
